title: Kilkenny Castle
scope: The restored standing three-wing Kilkenny Castle surrounding the open courtyard, including the Parade gateway, Picture Gallery wing and three large round towers.
limitations: The restored castle exterior and gateway are represented. Independent grounds structures and the lost medieval fourth wing are outside the asset.
The map gives current footprints and nominal heights. Traceries, concealed roof sections, corbels and textures use photo-based estimates.
